questions.subject: ITCS217_Computer Data Communication
questions.prompt: Which function selects a path across multiple networks?
questions.explanation: Routing selects paths across networks and is not a main Data Link Layer function.
optionExplanations: Routing selects paths across multiple networks.
Flow control regulates the sender relative to receiver capacity.
Media access control coordinates access to a shared medium.

questions.subject: ITCS217_Computer Data Communication
questions.prompt: Which are main Data Link Layer functions? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: The material identifies framing, flow control, error control, and media access control as main functions.
optionExplanations: Routing across networks is not a main Data Link Layer function.
Flow control is a main function.
Error control is a main function.
Signal encoding is not a main Data Link Layer function.
Media access control is a main function.
